rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the light reflected from the Moon.

example.english: The moonlight is beautiful tonight; sitting on the balcony enjoying the breeze is really comfortable.
example.traditional: 今晚啲月光好靚，坐喺露台度吹風真係好舒服。
